chapters.title: Measure generation as a semantic fork bomb

takeaways: AI agents editing Power BI and Fabric models produce architectural drift: definitions change quietly while reports keep working.
Measures, relationships, PBIR report files and MCP tool access are the main drift vectors, and logs alone cannot prove the intent behind a change.
Four gates — intent mapping, containment, semantic verification and attested release — let agents automate repetition without redefining business meaning.
hook: AI agents can build and refactor your Power BI and Fabric models at machine speed, but the numbers may quietly start answering different questions. This episode is for BI architects, data platform owners and governance leads who want agent speed without losing semantic truth. You learn where drift starts and a four-gate governance model that keeps meaning owned, verified and auditable.
